claims.title: Early renders showed a shared S23 family design direction
claims.summary: XDA reported OnLeaks renders of the Galaxy S23 and described an updated camera-module design shared with the S23+ direction, alongside a flat display and rounded edges.
claims.assessment: This is a whole-family design report anchored to named render material, while hardware details were still unknown at publication.
